explanation: The killing took away the king who had backed the dictatorship and the heir trained to succeed him. It left the throne to an eighteen-year-old with no standing of his own. The monarchy lost the capacity to have a battle fought for it. Its defenders spent the next thirty-two months in ministries too short-lived to govern. The republican movement had learned that it could strike at the regime directly and survive the striking. The revolution of October 1910 ran against a dynasty already broken in the Terreiro do Paço.
